item.title: Pet microchip company went out of business and took your pet's info with it
item.description: Texas-based pet microchip registry Save This Life abruptly shut down earlier this month, potentially leaving hundreds of thousands of pets unprotected. Microchipping is vital for protecting pets. Pets run away or get lost, and collars and tags can fall off. A microchip can be the difference between getting a pet back and losing them forever. — Read the rest The post Pet microchip company went out of business and took your pet's info with it appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: Bannon said that Trump was "beyond borderline" and should be removed via the 25th Amendment
